quote: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 on June 9, 2026.
note: Lab (Anthropic) and kind (shipped model) confirmed. The quoted date comes from a secondary article (Let's Data Science, dated June 10, 2026); the anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5 URL returned 404, so Anthropic's own launch post was not opened. Other search snippets (IT之家, reporting an Anthropic blog post of June 9) agree on June 9, but I did not open them; one snippet gave June 11 and was disregarded as conflicting with the X post timestamp. No preview or waitlist for Fable 5 was found before the public launch. A CNBC headline in the same article's source list mentions a 'private rollout' two months before launch; that appears to concern Claude Mythos Preview (April 7, 2026, Project Glasswing), not Fable 5, but this was not verified. Claude Mythos 5 was released alongside Fable 5 with limited access and is a separate system. Fable 5 was suspended under US export controls on June 12, 2026 and restored globally on July 1, 2026; that is a suspension and return, not a change to the first release date.
